metadata.description: spec-md — an agent-native specification framework for the software development lifecycle.

plugins.name: spec-md
plugins.description: The single /spec-md skill for *.spec.md work. It authors and maintains OKF specs that keep intent, behavior, and verification aligned across humans and agents, and it checks specs or reports test-case coverage. The skill identifies which job the request needs, or presents the options when the intent is unclear. One root SKILL.md — no commands and no nested skills — so it surfaces as the bare /spec-md, with no colon-suffixed sub-commands.
